title: Committed artifact primitives
responsibility: Decode committed JSON, calculate hashes and reject invalid artifact names.

inputs.name: hubJson.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes containing one UTF-8 JSON document to decode. UTF-8 decoding is fatal, and invalid UTF-8 or JSON syntax throws Error with code artifact-corrupt.

inputs.name: hubHash.value
inputs.description: Bytes to hash directly, or a string encoded as UTF-8 before hashing. The function computes a SHA-256 digest of the resulting bytes.

inputs.name: hubContractHash.value
inputs.description: A value passed to canonicalJson so its serialization can be hashed. Accepted shapes and serialization limits follow canonicalJson.

inputs.name: hubFail.code
inputs.description: Code attached to the Error thrown by this helper. When omitted, it defaults to artifact-corrupt.

inputs.name: hubFile.value
inputs.description: A filename of 1 to 200 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens, beginning with a letter or digit and containing no double period. Invalid values throw Error with code invalid-path.

outputs.name: hubJson
outputs.description: The JSON value returned by JSON.parse after fatal UTF-8 decoding. Any valid JSON root value is returned without schema validation.

outputs.name: hubHash
outputs.description: A Promise resolving to the lowercase 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the input bytes; string inputs are UTF-8 encoded first.

outputs.name: hubContractHash
outputs.description: A Promise resolving to the lowercase 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of canonicalJson(value). Serialization behavior and accepted values follow canonicalJson.

outputs.name: hubFail
outputs.description: Does not return; it throws an Error with message Harness artifact unavailable and a code property set to the supplied value. The code defaults to artifact-corrupt.

outputs.name: hubFile
outputs.description: The original filename string when the value passes the filename rule. Invalid names throw Error with code invalid-path.

errors.name: HarnessArtifactUnavailableError
errors.description: Invalid UTF-8 decoding or JSON parsing throws Error with message Invalid committed artifact and code artifact-corrupt.

errors.name: crypto.subtle.digest rejection
errors.description: If crypto.subtle.digest throws or rejects, the returned Promise rejects with that failure unchanged. This implementation does not specify a stable error name or message.

errors.name: canonicalJson or hubHash error
errors.description: Errors from canonicalJson(value) or rejection from hubHash propagate through the returned Promise unchanged. This implementation does not specify a stable error name or message.

errors.name: HarnessArtifactUnavailableError
errors.description: Calling this helper always throws Error with message Harness artifact unavailable and a code property equal to the supplied code, defaulting to artifact-corrupt.

errors.name: HarnessArtifactUnavailableError
errors.description: A value that fails the filename rule throws Error with message Harness artifact unavailable and code invalid-path via hubFail.
